0022600142.text: The Thunder come into this 5th game of the season at 3-0, with a 1-0 road record, first place in the Northwest, and a three-game winning streak, while the Mavericks are 2-2 and sit 3rd in the Southwest, 1.5 games back, after winning their last game. Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), Otega Oweh (Achilles, surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee), and Alex Caruso is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision, while Dallas is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Naji Marshall (illness), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), with Sergio de Larrea day-to-day with a knee strain and also a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Thunder won the 2025-26 series 3-0, including a 100-87 win in Dallas on March 1, 2026.
